title: UI wave 2 U1: Motion tokens and a motion-safe stylesheet sweep (A, part 1)
description: Plan task U1. Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-26-ui-wave-2/PLAN.md exactly: this task's section (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) plus the seven answered Open questions and the Notes for the implementer. Protocol: register the serial check slot via files add only right before the first expensive check and keep it until done; pinned Node; quoted --outDir; no installs, no commits; status CLAIMED; independent review required.

handoff.text:
REJECT (reviewer agent-a017). Two visible defects; everything else passes.
PROBLEM 1 -- stop-and-ask item hit: Chromium shows the field border when the search is CLOSED. src/components/library.css:20 clip-path: inset(1px 1px 1px calc(100% - 27px)) puts the clip edge exactly on the border's inner edge; in Chromium a ~26px-wide row of --line at ~50% intensity shows along the slot's top edge above the magnifier (raw pixels 237,238,240 on 255 white light; 48,48,52 on 32,32,35 dark; both palettes, 1440x900 and 850x600; bottom/sides clean). Native WebKit is clean (see below). FIX: keep the closed clip edge at least 1px inside the border, e.g. inset(2px 2px 2px calc(100% - 26px)) (button is 26x26 at 1..27; icon is 15px so nothing visible is lost), then re-screenshot closed in Chromium and confirm the slot's top row has no non-background pixels.
PROBLEM 2 -- open field: placeholder/typed text is flush against the left border and focus ring (the S of 'Search projects' touches the ring; light-850-open-left8x.png). Cause: row-reverse moved the input to the LEFT of the magnifier but src/components/library.css:52 '.library-search-field > input { padding: 0 var(--space-2) 0 0 }' still pads the right (button) side. FIX: padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-2) (or both sides). Same CSS in every engine, so a regression natively too.
CHECKS RUN: tsc --noEmit exit 0. vitest motion+designTokens+palette 3 files 22/22. npm test --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1: 52 files 906/906, exit 0 (ui2-u1-review/unit.log). vite build to ui2-u1-review/dist exit 0. Playwright port 1591 projects-screen+appearance+layout+sidebar-selection 55/55, retries 0 (ui2-u1-review/pw.log). Fail-first on a scratch copy (deleted after): editor.css focus-dim back to 140ms -> (b) fails 1/7 naming editor.css; plus width transition, 0.2s longhand, @keyframes, --duration-base 200ms -> (a)(b)(c)(d)(e) fail 5/7. motion.test.ts genuinely asserts (a)-(f) (minor: (b) checks only the first time in a shorthand item, so a literal delay would slip; (e) matches the first occurrence anywhere, not scoped to :root -- not blocking). grep for literal transition times: no output. grep transition/animation/@keyframes over all 8 src css files: only the tokenised declarations plus the reduced-motion 'none' blocks -- nothing missed. ProjectLibrary.tsx: wrapper only; every attribute, id, aria label, ref, handler and button-then-input order unchanged; data-open stays on .library-search. Geometry (open, Chromium): 1440 field 671.8-891.8 vs create right 588.2, Sort label from 907.8; 850 field 361.8-581.8 vs create right 308.2, Sort from 597.8 -> no overlap, that stop-and-ask item NOT triggered. Smoke rebuild (debug, native-smoke) exit 0 (ui2-u1-review/smoke.log); native-screens 10 PNGs exit 0.
SCREENSHOTS VIEWED: chromium/light-850-closed.png (faint line visible above magnifier); chromium/light-1440-closed-zoom.png + crop8x (line above magnifier); chromium/dark-1440-closed-zoom.png and dark-850-closed-crop8x.png (same line, dark); chromium/light-850-open-zoom.png (open field clear of create button and Sort; text flush left); chromium/dark-1440-open-zoom.png (same, dark; ring visible inside border); chromium/light-850-open-left8x.png (S touching ring); native/projects-light.png (2x) and native/projects-dark.png (1x): closed magnifier clean, pixel scan of the slot found only icon rows, no border row. Native script cannot open search, so open-state WebKit not checked.
DEVIATIONS: (1) 27px clip -- right intent (plan's 28px would box the magnifier) but insufficient in Chromium, see Problem 1. (2) focus ring at -3px on the open field, -2px on the magnifier when closed -- sound (clip-path clips outside outlines); open ring confirmed in screenshots, closed-state keyboard ring not visually verified. (3) data-open='true'/absent -- sound; React renders boolean true on data-* as 'true', so the plan's '' could never match.

review.note: Coordinator review of cycle 2: library.css:20 closed clip inset(2px 2px 2px calc(100% - 26px)) and :52 padding-left var(--space-2) fix both agent-a017 findings. New Playwright tests (closed-slot top-row pixel spread <=3 light+dark; open input paddingLeft>=4) failed on c1 per worker, pass now. pw3.log 57 passed; vitest 22/22. Viewed light-850-open.png: placeholder clear of left border. tsc exit 2 is only T122's in-progress unused imports in export files, not T098 paths. Native not rerun (tighter clip only; c1 native clean). Cycle-1 reviewer's minor test gaps (shorthand delay, :root scoping) noted, not blocking.

Fail-first: motion.test.ts on untouched tree -> 4 of 7 failed: (a) library.css width/border-color, (b) six literal durations (120ms,180ms x2,0.15s x2,140ms), (c) six non-token easings, (e) tokens missing. After: vitest motion+designTokens 13/13 pass; tsc exit 0; grep for literal transition times: no output. Playwright PREVIEW(1) port 1571 (projects-screen, appearance, layout, sidebar-selection): 54 passed, 1 failed first run (my spec asserted data-open="" but React renders "true"; test-only fix), then projects-screen.spec.ts rerun 32/32 pass (log ui2-u1/pw3.log; first full log pw.log). Deviations: (1) closed clip is inset(1px 1px 1px calc(100% - 27px)) not 28px, so the field border is hidden when closed (plan's inset would show a box around the magnifier); (2) clip-path also clips outlines drawn outside the border box, so open focus ring uses outline-offset -3px on the field and the closed state shows the ring on the magnifier button (offset -2px); (3) spec checks data-open="true"/absence. Not done: native WebKit check of clip border (plan stop-and-ask), no screenshots reviewed; only Chromium run. 850x600 field-vs-create-button test passes in Chromium.
